recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No semantic source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31357; a spelling-only cleanup in the existing paragraph can be handled separately as ordinary editorial maintenance if desired.
issue_request: FHIR-31357 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked FHIR-I/SDC to surface guidance explaining that nested items under questions go beneath each answer, nested items under groups go directly beneath item.item, and the hierarchy is retained so multiple answers can each carry their own child items.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites c6f0f9424d, which added a Nested Items section to source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-notes.xml. That section remains in the active QuestionnaireResponse notes and states the two mechanisms, item.item and item.answer.item, and why answer-level nesting is needed for questions with multiple answers.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is active in source/fhir.ini. The active StructureDefinition also carries matching comments on QuestionnaireResponse.item, QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item, and QuestionnaireResponse.item.item. Older related FHIR-10481 and FHIR-20768 decisions kept both recursion points and asked for clearer guidance rather than removing item.answer.item; FHIR-26356 clarified the nearby qrs-1 invariant; later FHIR-38853 clarified repeating groups without reversing the FHIR-31357 rule and is already represented on the combined branch. Confluence minutes confirm the SDC vote accepting FHIR-31357 as Persuasive, and Zulip searches found historical implementer confusion but no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already conveys the approved nesting rule in QuestionnaireResponse notes and reinforces it in element comments, so adding or changing semantic prose would be redundant for this issue.
